name: R3D Polytope Splitting and Moment Reduction
definition: A voxelization technique that computes exact coordinate moments of the intersection between a 3D polytope and a Cartesian grid by recursively splitting the polytope along grid axes until it fits within a single voxel, then reducing the polytope's moments to that voxel.
summary: R3D Polytope Splitting and Moment Reduction is a voxelization technique that recursively splits arbitrary convex polyhedra along grid axes to compute exact coordinate moments within individual voxels.
